items.description: A broad municipal blade stamped PAID BREAKS ARE A DAMAGE TYPE. The stamp is legally decorative and tactically sincere.
items.power_text: Dena deals 3 additional damage when her Strike consumes Exposed.

items.description: The visor highlights whoever plans to hit you. It also highlights coworkers thinking about scheduling a meeting.
items.power_text: Dena's Guard also grants 2 Guard to the ally facing the largest declared hit.

items.description: Every dent has been notarized. Every notary has requested reassignment.
items.power_text: After Dena blocks an enemy hit, she counterattacks that enemy for 3 damage.

items.description: A tiny iron committee table. It seats four and blames five.
items.power_text: Guard Dena grants to Moss primes Moss's next Power to spread.

items.description: It becomes sharper after normal business hours, which in the dungeon began several geological eras ago.
items.power_text: Dena counterattacks for 5 damage after blocking a hit and gains 1 Guard.

items.description: Technically armor. Functionally a building code violation with excellent posture.
items.power_text: Dena begins every combat with 4 Guard.

items.description: A crooked wand whose license is valid in three sewers and one aggressively damp post office.
items.power_text: A primed Moss Power splashes 2 damage and 1 Weakening to a second enemy.

items.description: The collar whispers that confidence is just mold with better branding.
items.power_text: Moss's Power deals 2 additional damage.

items.description: Open only in a ventilated room or during an argument you are prepared to win incorrectly.
items.power_text: Moss's Strike consumes 1 Weakening from the target for 4 bonus damage.

items.description: It understands what the pipes are going through and intends to make everyone else understand too.
items.power_text: Any Guard gained by Moss primes her next Power to spread.

items.description: A legendary wand for leaders who prefer actionable curses and quarterly mildew.
items.power_text: Moss's Power always splashes 4 damage and 2 Weakening to a second enemy.

items.description: You were not there. The spores resembling your silhouette are acting independently.
items.power_text: Moss gains 2 Guard whenever her Power Weakens at least one enemy.

items.description: A wrench with seventeen settings. Sixteen are LEVERAGE. The last is EVIDENCE.
items.power_text: Vell's primed pressure-line Power also Exposes every surviving enemy.

items.description: Every pocket contains another pocket. Inventory capacity remains somebody else's problem.
items.power_text: Vell gains 2 Guard after using Utility.

items.description: It repeats the useful part of any bad idea on the nearest available target.
items.power_text: Vell's Utility splashes 3 damage to a second living enemy.

items.display_name: Charm of Just One More Valve
items.description: The tiny wheel turns freely and controls something important in a different postal district.
items.power_text: A primed pressure-line Power deals 2 additional damage to every enemy.

items.description: Elected by a landslide after every opposing tool was found inside a locked drain.
items.power_text: Pressure-line Power deals 3 extra damage and applies 3 Exposed to survivors.

items.description: Complies with all regulations that Vell remembers and several he invented while sewing.
items.power_text: Vell begins every combat with 3 Guard.

items.description: A healer's staff curved to catch patients, allies, and preventable outcomes before they reach the floor.
items.power_text: Ilex's Power grants the healed ally 2 bonus damage on their next Strike this round.

items.description: The embroidered warning reads I TOLD YOU SO in six emergency triage dialects.
items.power_text: Ilex's Power restores 3 additional Vitality.

items.description: It applies treatment shortly before the patient agrees that treatment was required.
items.power_text: Ilex's Power grants the healed ally 3 Guard.

items.description: Proof that someone was healthier than required and the surplus has been reassigned by committee.
items.power_text: Overhealing becomes Guard on the healed ally, up to 4.

items.display_name: Staff of the Last Reasonable Person
items.description: A legendary staff that gets heavier whenever everyone else says this will probably be fine.
items.power_text: Ilex heals 4 more and grants the healed ally 4 Guard.

items.description: Dry on the inside, judgmental on the outside, and banned from three indoor cisterns.
items.power_text: Ilex begins every combat with 3 Guard.

items.description: The meeting achieved one Strike, one Power, one Guard, one Utility, and no agreement about lunch.
items.power_text: Using all four different commands in one plan grants every living member 2 Guard before retaliation.

items.description: It glows when danger is near and also when soup is near. Triage remains contextual.
items.power_text: Every living party member begins round one with 1 Guard.

items.description: Ring once for danger. Ring twice for danger that has now been properly scheduled.
items.power_text: The first Strike each round deals 3 bonus damage.

items.description: Complimentary means free. The rail's opinion of your footing is considerably less complimentary.
items.power_text: The first ally to receive a declared hit each round gains 2 Guard.

items.description: It illuminates safe rest areas and union breaks. Management insists those are unrelated features.
items.power_text: Whenever a member Guards, the lowest-Vitality ally gains 1 Guard.

items.description: The first drain was merely decorative. This one has read the mission brief and is furious.
items.power_text: The first environmental Power each combat repeats for 2 damage to all surviving enemies.

items.description: Every form returns to its beginning except the reimbursement form, which has achieved escape velocity.
items.power_text: The first Utility each round applies 1 Exposed to a second enemy.

items.description: Rejected by all known gods and accepted by one suspicious snack machine beneath the cistern.
items.power_text: A varied four-command plan grants 3 Guard and 1 next-Strike bonus to every living member.
